lines.en: I give Ami a call and, feeling generous today, decide to take her to the mall so she can complain about how I never buy her anything and get too close to me in public.
lines.zh: 我给 Ami 打了个电话，今天心情大方，决定带她去商场，好让她抱怨我从来不给她买东西，并在公共场合贴我贴得太近。

lines.en: In hindsight, I was probably just bored- as I can not envision any version of myself generous enough to endure such niecely activities.
lines.zh: 事后想来，我大概只是无聊——因为我没法想象自己会大方到忍耐这种「侄女式」活动。

lines.en: The two of us move from store to store, but it’s more like I’m being {i}dragged{/i} from store to store than anything else.
lines.zh: 我俩一家店一家店地走，但与其说是走，不如说是我在被{i}拖{/i}着走。

lines.en: I think all of the maid cafe money must be going to Ami’s head as she winds up picking up at least one item from basically every business we step into.
lines.zh: 我觉得女仆咖啡厅赚的钱肯定把 Ami 给烧晕了——我们踏进的每一家店，她基本都要拿上至少一件东西。

lines.en: Well, every business beside Chika’s...which she still made a conscious effort to go into, likely to rub the fact that the two of us were hanging out in Chika’s face.
lines.zh: 哦，除了 Chika 的店……不过她还是有意识地专程进去晃了一圈，大概是为了把「我俩在一块儿玩」这件事当面甩给 Chika 看。

lines.en: Thankfully (And surprisingly), Chika trusts me enough to believe that there’s nothing more to this and locks herself into the preconceived notion that Ami is just...very clingy.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地（而且令人意外），Chika 足够信任我，相信这中间没别的意思，并把自己锁进那个预设里——认定 Ami 只是……很黏人。

lines.en: Which, to be fair, she is.
But her feelings are obviously much greater than that.
lines.zh: 但她的感情显然远不止于此。

lines.en: If they weren’t, she wouldn’t keep insisting to every employee in every store that I need to accompany her into the dressing room- a thing that not a single person has bought so far.
lines.zh: 要不是的话，她就不会一直跟每家店的每个店员坚持说我必须陪她进试衣间——而这说法到目前为止一个人都没买账。

lines.en: It’s gotten to the point where I just walk away whenever she says that now.
lines.zh: 现在已经到了她一说这个我就直接走开的程度。

lines.en: Eventually, we run out of stores to shop from and dressing rooms to {i}not{/i} enter and have to leave the mall before Ami spends the remainder of her paycheck on pointless accessories.
lines.zh: 最后，我们终于逛完了所有能逛的店、也走完了所有{i}没能{/i}进去的试衣间，只好在 Ami 把剩下的工资全砸在没用的配饰上之前离开商场。

lines.en: And, even though it’s a little annoying, the two of us grow a little closer in the process.
lines.zh: 虽然有点烦人，但在这个过程中，我俩的关系又近了一点。

lines.en: But, it is at that moment that I begin to wonder just how much closer we can possibly get.
lines.zh: 可也正是在那一刻，我开始怀疑，我们到底还能再近到什么地步。
